title: Stagewise and interpretable emergence of inside-outside computation in Transformer-based language models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14221v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Variability in syntactic structure and parsing ambiguity are fundamental aspects of natural language which modern LLMs have to learn to deal with proficiently. Previous "post-mortem" studies have shown that fully trained Transformers indeed approximate canonical parsing algorithms such as inside-outside, but little is established theoretically about how this is actually learned. Here, we make a first step towards addressing this by studying the learning dynamics in synthetic context-free grammars with variable parse tree topology. The stagewise learning curves are fully interpretable, in the sense that all of the loss stages a) can be computed analytically, and b) can be clearly associated to the representation of a hidden latent tree variable, which allows to lift ambiguity and utilize information from wider contexts. By probing representations, we visualize the emergence of inside-outside computation across depth and during training: w

translated_title: 基于Transformer的语言模型中内外计算的分阶段可解释涌现
translated_abstract: 句法结构的变异性和句法分析中的歧义是自然语言的基本特征，现代大语言模型必须学会熟练地处理这些问题。以往的“事后”研究表明，训练完成的Transformer确实能够近似诸如inside-outside（内外算法）之类的经典句法分析算法，但对于这种能力实际上是如何被学习到的，理论上仍知之甚少。本文朝解决这一问题迈出了第一步：我们研究了在具有可变句法分析树拓扑结构的合成上下文无关文法中的学习动态。这些阶段性的学习曲线是完全可解释的，具体而言，损失函数的所有阶段a) 都可以被解析地计算出来，b) 都可以清晰地与一个隐藏的潜在树变量的表示相关联，该变量能够消除歧义并利用更广泛上下文中的信息。通过对模型表示进行探测，我们可视化了inside-outside计算在网络深度方向上以及训练过程中如何涌现。
tldr: 本文首次通过研究具有可变句法树结构的合成上下文无关文法中的学习动态，展示了Transformer语言模型如何分阶段、可解释地涌现出inside-outside句法分析计算，其中每个损失阶段均可被解析计算并与潜在树变量表示的涌现明确关联。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first study of how Transformers stagewise and interpretably acquire inside-outside parsing computation, showing that every loss stage in training on synthetic context-free grammars can be analytically computed and linked to the emergence of a latent tree variable representation that resolves ambiguity and exploits wider context.
